mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food (id, store_id, name, price, description) VALUES (#{id}, #{storeId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.store_id, f.name, f.price, f.description, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.blinded_at FROM food f JOIN root r ON f.id = r.id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE food f JOIN root r ON f.id = r.id SET f.name = #{name}, f.price = #{price}, f.description = #{description}, r.updated_at = NOW() WHERE f.id = #{id}
